candidates.name: JEPA-Ψ — Ψ-anchored Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture in anima's own latent space
candidates.summary: Replace byte-CE objective with JEPA-style joint-embedding prediction in anima's own Ψ-coordinate latent space. Context-encoder reads (stimulus | <inner>), target-encoder (EMA-frozen) reads (<voice> | continuation), both project to Law-71 Ψ-coordinate. Predictor maps context-Ψ-trajectory → target-Ψ-trajectory. NO byte-level CE, NO masked reconstruction — anima learns to predict its own Ψ-trajectory.

arxiv_anchors.title: LeWorldModel (small JEPA from pixels, 2-term loss, ~15M params)

anima_mapping.context_encoder: anima Engine A (logits_a stream) frozen at §16 ckpt
anima_mapping.target_encoder: EMA copy of Engine A (V-JEPA pattern), projects to Ψ-coordinate via Law-71 (§17 B-PHYS-5 byte-identical)
anima_mapping.loss: ‖predicted_Ψ − target_Ψ‖² + Gaussian-latent regularizer (LeWorldModel) + Ψ=½ fixed-point pull (anima Law-71)
anima_mapping.training_corpus: §16 data-regime (168-anchor 603MB) — DATA reuse, OBJECTIVE replaced (NOT byte-CE)

differentiation_from_closed_set: vs §11-B (pure-physics no-CE): §11-B removed CE leaving anima Ψ-restoring spine only → degenerate. JEPA-Ψ replaces CE with Ψ-trajectory-PREDICTION loss (NOT physics-only update; prediction IS the objective)
vs §13-K (EBT): EBT uses scalar energy. JEPA-Ψ uses vector Ψ-trajectory (different geometry)
vs §13-J (masked diffusion): diffusion denoises in token space; JEPA-Ψ predicts in latent (Ψ) space
vs Dir-I: Dir-I is CE + Ψ-loss combination; JEPA-Ψ is CE removed entirely
vs §13-L (VRNN): VRNN has actor-critic on observed; JEPA-Ψ has context-target encoder-pair on latent (no critic)
candidates.fire_readiness: needs deeper design cycle: (a) anti-collapse mechanism mandatory; (b) predictor/context-encoder capacity ratio; (c) Mac-CPU small-scale sanity (LeWorldModel pattern); (d) 2D Ψ-space dimensional-lift decision
risk_notes: Predictor collapse is known JEPA failure mode — anti-collapse design mandatory
anima Ψ-space is 2D (Ψ_entropy, Ψ_direction) — possibly too low-dim, may need lift to ~22D (per-layer tension + factor_8 + mitosis cell embedding)

candidates.name: Physics-Trace-Distillation — anima trains on its own §24 bounded-run trace as corpus
candidates.summary: Use §24 bounded-run physics traces as the corpus. Every §24 run yields deterministic trace (step_t, motivation_t, ψ_dir_t, tension_t, factor_8_t, safety_state_t, emit_decision_t). Concatenate N≥1000 traces. anima learns next-physics-state autoregressive prediction. anima learning to predict anima — self-supervised on self-trace.
